# Linear Algebra for Machine Learning

> Compute vectors, projections, least squares and the SVD by hand and in array code, and judge when a numerical result can be trusted. SDAIA Academy course FND-MTH-101, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 18,477 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Week 1: Vectors and similarity](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week1.md): Data as vectors, and the angle between them as similarity; sessions: Vectors, dot products and similarity; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week1.html; about 2,978 tokens
- [Week 2: Matrices as maps, and their cost](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week2.md): A matrix product is a map, a table of dot products and a bill for arithmetic; sessions: Matrix products, attention scores and FLOPs; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week2.html; about 2,096 tokens
- [Week 3: Span, rank and linear systems](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week3.md): When columns repeat each other, and what that does to a system of equations; sessions: Span, rank and linear systems; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week3.html; about 2,067 tokens
- [Week 4: Orthogonal projection and QR](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week4.md): The nearest point in a subspace, and a basis that makes it easy; sessions: Orthogonal projection and QR; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week4.html; about 1,971 tokens
- [Week 5: Least squares and conditioning](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week5.md): Least squares is a projection; conditioning decides how far to trust it; sessions: Least squares and conditioning; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week5.html; about 2,062 tokens
- [Week 6: Eigenvectors and link ranking](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week6.md): Directions a matrix only stretches, and the page a random reader ends on; sessions: Eigenvectors and link ranking; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week6.html; about 2,084 tokens
- [Week 7: Singular values and low rank](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week7.md): Every matrix is a sum of rank-one layers, largest first; sessions: The SVD and principal components; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week7.html; about 2,022 tokens
- [Week 8: Low rank in practice, and working numerically](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week8.md): Low-rank models in recommenders and adapters, and code you can trust; sessions: Low rank in practice; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/week8.html; about 1,973 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone oral checks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/capstone.md): Ten minutes each: four to walk through the notebook, six to rework one step with new numbers; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/slides/capstone.html; about 1,115 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Cosine-similarity search over public sentence embeddings](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/labs/W1_1.ipynb): Week 1, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 2.1: Loop and vectorised matrix products, timed and costed in FLOPs](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/labs/W2_1.ipynb): Week 2, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 3.1: Rank and linear systems on a feature table](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/labs/W3_1.ipynb): Week 3, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 4.1: Projections and QR by Gram-Schmidt](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/labs/W4_1.ipynb): Week 4, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 5.1: Least squares by normal equations and by QR on nearly collinear data](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/labs/W5_1.ipynb): Week 5, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 6.1: Power iteration and link ranking on a synthetic web graph](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/labs/W6_1.ipynb): Week 6, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 7.1: SVD image compression and PCA on public handwritten digits](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/labs/W7_1.ipynb): Week 7, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 8.1: Low-rank ratings and adapter updates, checked by hand](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-101/labs/W8_1.ipynb): Week 8, Session 1, 105 min
